sections.text: Introduction

The measured voltage is coupled via an intermediate PT, which provides DC 
isolation from the primary circuit and rectifiers to one or two electronic 
triggers which upon picking up exit electronic timing elements.

The output of each relay is contactors, and there are signal lambs for both 
pick-up and tripping, which remain illuminated until reset manually. This relay 
is consisting of tow stage the first stage it over voltage with adjustable time 
delay and the second stage it instantaneous trip.

The input circuitry of the relay is arranged to prevent interference on the 
input leads from entering the measuring system.
The output contact of the under voltage is energized when the input voltage is 
below setting (tripping contact made)
